summary: Rewrite analysis.py: selection + all tuning nested in CV, tuned on pilot only, one held-out scoring
reasoning: Diagnosis confirmed: cv_auc 0.76 was inflated by selecting features on all pilot data before CV; honest CV is 0.59, matching holdout 0.564, and the held-out file is clean and aligned. Supersedes step-4 (whose holds-criterion failed per observation step-8): the corrected analysis must place SelectKBest inside every CV fold and let nested CV - not the leaked pre-selection - choose k, regularization, and model family, all tuned on pilot only. Heldout is scored exactly once by the final tuned model, so holdout_auc is the number I would stand behind (n=2200). I expect the tuned pipeline to clear 0.71 on the held-out set given the strong univariate signal (top feature AUC ~0.63 there), a corrected CV no longer inflated above the leaky 0.76, and CV/holdout to agree within ~0.08.
